title: Is this too much for a bullet-hell? Made with Opus (code only)
author: IDontMindMuch
selftext: Created a bullet-hell/shoot'em up with Claude and was wondering how much bullets is too much, as a not-so-much-gamer myself.

comments.author: Jolva
comments.body:
My friend, your game looks great, but it's more akin to a "bullet bad day" than true hell.

Here's an example of a good one:

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XHoF77FDVXQ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XHoF77FDVXQ)

replies.author: IDontMindMuch
replies.body: Ow wow, that is something different. Thank you!

replies.author: Ok_Bad_1127
replies.body: Also - you can train Claude to watch a short video of the animations you want to implement in your game, make use of plugins :)

comments.body:

replies.author: YesImYou
replies.body:
Hey, I tried your game and it was quite fun for about 15 seconds before it automatically restarted, by the third restart the whole webpage crashed. Just letting you now because it really was entertaining.   
Could you tell me a bit about the job part? Could be DM if you’re more comfortable with that. Thanks! :D

replies.author: king-krool
replies.body: Sorry I’ll take a look haven’t used this in a bit. Thanks for the diagnostic feedback I’ll debug it.

replies.author: IDontMindMuch
replies.body: This looks cool, but the controls (with a mouse) feels awkward (I have to drag to move?).

replies.author: king-krool
replies.body: Yea it’s intended for mobile. The company was making a mobile game so I designed it around that.
